Name: George's Gift
Author: Korporate
Description:
[color=#ffffff][b][size=4]George's Gift[/size]
[/b]by Korporate

[b][size=4]What it does:[/size]
[/b]A thoughtful item left by George when he worked as a miner. Places a chest with message and a mountains warp totem for anyone who gets themself stranded in the quarry when the bridge is out. A lore-friendly way to rescue players who discover the chair exploit in the mine entrance. The chest is single-use – it despawns after the warp totem is removed and and won't respawn after.

[b][size=4]Requirements:[/size]
[/b]Stardew Valley 1.6
SMAPI 4.0.0

[b][size=4]Notes:[/size]
[/b]The chair is the most powerful item in the game.[/color]

Manifest.Name: George's Gift
Manifest.Description: Places a one-time chest in the quarry mine entrance containing a Warp Totem: Mountains — a helping hand from George for any miner who finds themselves stranded.
